description: Ministry of Finance & Mass Media - Rules made under the Public Service Mutual Provident Association Ordinance
reasoning: This gazette notification contains amendments to the rules of the Public Service Mutual Provident Association, specifically detailing changes to loan entitlements, retirement allowances, and membership contributions for public servants. The content focuses on public sector service conditions and benefits, falling under the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) which cover "Public service recruitment and examinations," "Service conditions and benefits," and "Pension and retirement benefits."
